""" 
augmentation as adding new variables that weren't originally present in the dataset. The augment document should create the database used by all subsequent analyses. 

For your experiment, I'd consider these additions:
New variable	Derived from	Purpose
condition	time + stimulus	Identify each experimental condition
time_numeric	time	Represent 4h and 24h numerically, if needed
infection_status	stimulus	Distinguish RPMI controls from fungal stimulation

You don't necessarily need all three. Choose variables that will actually help your analyses.

One important point: keep time and stimu as categorical variables when treating them as experimental groups. Don't replace them with numerical values just because you can.

Also, don't confuse augmentation with normalisation. Calculating CPM or log-transformed expression values is a separate analytical processing decision.
"""
